intro: Three lenses on how I work: what I'm like (OCEAN), how I prefer to act (conation), and how I come across (DISC). These are self-reported results from assessments, used here as a guide, not a verdict.

traits.name: Openness to experience
traits.meaning: Curious and imaginative: new tech, big ideas, sci-fi, physics.

traits.name: Conscientiousness
traits.meaning: Balanced: can be organised, but doesn't live by rules. Systems help.

traits.name: Extraversion
traits.meaning: Energised by people: camera, live sessions, crowds, stand-up.

traits.name: Agreeableness
traits.meaning: Very direct and tough-minded: challenges ideas and says what the data says.

traits.name: Neuroticism
traits.meaning: Very calm under pressure: steady when things break, resilient after setbacks.

conation.title: ⚡ Conation (Kolbe modes)
conation.note: How you naturally take action, scored 1–10. 1–3: you resist this mode. 4–6: you flex with it. 7–10: you lead with it.

modes.name: Fact Finder
modes.meaning: Wants the bottom line, not the whole report. Cuts to what matters.

modes.name: Follow Thru
modes.meaning: Resists rigid systems and schedules. Switches tasks and improvises.

modes.name: Quick Start
modes.meaning: Starts fast, experiments, takes risks, loves the new. Early to every disruption.

modes.name: Implementor
modes.meaning: Can get hands-on and fix physical or concrete things when needed, but doesn't lead with it.

disc.title: 🎯 DISC
disc.meaning: I-D: an energetic persuader who also drives results. You inspire people and move them to act fast.

together.title: 🧑‍✈️ Put together: a natural Delivery Pilot, if the follow-through is automated
together.text: Quick Start 9 with Openness 75 and Extraversion 85 makes a fast-starting, people-energised innovator. Follow Thru 2 and Fact Finder 3 mean the routine work and the deep research are where things slip. That's exactly what the Delivery Pilot model hands to agents: you set the route and the energy, and the machines handle the checklists.

implications.title: Why the 3-videos-a-week limit exists
implications.detail: Quick Start 9 starts everything at once (week 1 had 6 in flight). The limit protects the plan from your best trait.

implications.title: Automate the follow-through
implications.detail: Follow Thru 2: let the weekly routine, the reports and the agents do the checking, scheduling and logging. Don't rely on willpower for it.

implications.title: Outsource the deep research
implications.detail: Fact Finder 3: let Claude gather the data and sources for Pillar 2 videos, and you deliver the bottom line on camera.

implications.title: Lead with energy on camera
implications.detail: Extraversion 85 and I-D: live sessions, the animated co-host, comedy and improv suit you more than scripted lectures.

implications.title: Use the directness, then add warmth
implications.detail: Agreeableness 0 powers 'The data says otherwise' takes. Pair it with the Max Amini warmth so it reads as honest, not harsh.

implications.title: Stay the calm pilot
implications.detail: Neuroticism 5: you stay steady when things break. That's the pilot in the storm, and it's worth showing on camera during live debugging.

workingWith.title: 🤝 Working with Erdem (for people and agents)
tips: Give the bottom line first, then the detail if asked
Let him start fast, and build the follow-up into tools and routines
Be direct: blunt feedback is welcome
Bring energy and new ideas, and keep meetings short
